description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Mirror Image.
When Mirror Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.name: Mirror Image
uses.cardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night
